author: GamingBolt
description:
Asobo Studio has delivered two consecutive narratively compelling and tightly designed experiences in the Plague Tale games, but with its third instalment, the series has shifted course quite dramatically. Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy sheds the stealth driven gameplay of its predecessors, instead delivering a bombastic, action packed, combat focused adventure. 

The results, on the gameplay front, are quite different- and, thankfully, quite spectacular. And as players prepare to dive into Sophia’s journey in the action-adventure title, here, we have put together a handy list of tips and tricks that should help make things smoother in your early hours with the game, and perhaps beyond. With all of that out of the way, let’s dive in.
title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy  - 15 Things It Doesn't Tell You

author: GamingBolt
description:
Gears of War: E-Day is one of 2026's most anticipated games, and is a sort of introduction to a conflict that has been a part of modern gaming’s history. That alone makes it a very tempting offer for franchise fans and newcomers alike, and we’re glad to say that we’ve seen bit of the story to know that it’s a strong pillar of the Gears experience.

We’re fans of how the narrative and gameplay have managed to blend together as seamlessly as they have, and this one’s a story that we can’t wait to roll the credits on. 

How does The Coalition’s upcoming addition to its long-standing franchise achieve that balance? Join us as we take you through our hands-on with a title that’s been pretty high on our list of priorities for the year.
title: Gears of War: E-Day's Campaign Feels Like Classic Gears Is Finally Back [NEW Gameplay]

author: GamingBolt
description:
To say Rockstar had a lot to live up to with its Extended Look at Grand Theft Auto 6 would be an understatement. But after nearly 27 minutes, we came away suitably impressed with Vice City, Leonida, and the exploits of Lucia, Jason and the rest of the insane cast. Beyond showcasing all kinds of different activities and some gorgeous sights, it also highlighted several new systems in play.

Let's delve into 25 insane details you probably missed from the Extended Look, and how they impact the gameplay in several notable ways.

title: GTA 6 - 25 INSANE Details You Probably Missed In The 27-Minute Gameplay
